nodes.label: Alaska's financial-responsibility and mandatory-insurance laws aim to protect road users from uninsured drivers.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An owner or driver at fault in a collision must pay for damage or injuries caused to another person under the financial-responsibility law.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: No single interchangeable alternative is asserted for this complete source condition; related requirements keep separate nodes and their exact qualifiers.

nodes.label: A reasonable possibility of civil liability after a crash can result in driving privileges being suspended for as long as three years.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: No single interchangeable alternative is asserted for this complete source condition; related requirements keep separate nodes and their exact qualifiers.

nodes.label: A financial settlement with the other crash parties may end the financial-responsibility suspension during its three-year period.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The owner or driver must carry liability insurance under Alaska's mandatory-insurance law.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: No single interchangeable alternative is asserted for this complete source condition; related requirements keep separate nodes and their exact qualifiers.

nodes.label: The manual lists bodily-injury-or-death liability limits of fifty thousand dollars and one hundred thousand dollars but does not distinguish the application of those two limits in this paragraph.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The listed minimum property-damage liability coverage is twenty-five thousand dollars.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Proof of liability insurance must be carried in the vehicle.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Failure to show an officer proof of liability insurance can lead to a traffic citation or impoundment of the vehicle.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The manual's insurance-law paragraph requires proof to DMV within fifteen days after a crash involving injury, death or property damage exceeding five hundred one dollars.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: All drivers involved in a qualifying crash must provide insurance proof, even a driver who did not cause the collision.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The DMV insurance notification is separate from a report to police or to an insurance company.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: An investigating officer normally supplies an insurance-certificate form, and the form is also available from DMV offices or the state website.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Being uninsured or missing the fifteen-day proof deadline results in a ninety-day suspension for a first occurrence and a one-year suspension for a second occurrence, according to the manual.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: After any crash, stop immediately and move the vehicle out of traffic if doing so is possible.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Warn approaching traffic after a crash; use flares or other road signals at night and avoid stepping in front of vehicles.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Help injured people after a crash, arrange an ambulance when needed and move an injured person only when necessary.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The crash guidance says to control serious bleeding and keep the injured person warm.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Exchange names, addresses, driver-license and plate numbers, telephone numbers and insurance-company names with other drivers after a crash.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Record the identities of as many crash witnesses as possible.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: For a crash involving injury or at least two thousand dollars in total property damage within a municipality, immediately call local police using nine-one-one.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: For the same injury or damage circumstances outside a municipality, immediately contact Alaska State Troopers.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Cooperate with the officer investigating a collision.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The manual requires a DMV crash report within ten days, except when a police officer investigated the crash.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A DMV crash report may be submitted electronically or by using the crash-report form available at DMV offices or on its website.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: After hitting an unattended vehicle or private property, stop and try to find its owner; if unsuccessful, leave a note with your name, address and telephone number.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: The crash-checklist paragraph requires an insurance certificate for property damage of at least five hundred one dollars, submitted within fifteen days even if proof was shown during the police investigation.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Moving-violation convictions receive point values from two through ten, with more crash-prone violations receiving higher values.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Accumulating twelve points within twelve months or eighteen points within twenty-four months requires suspension or revocation despite personal hardship.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A points-based suspension or revocation does not offer a limited work-purpose license.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Drivers receive a warning when they reach half the point total that triggers suspension.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Violation-free driving and completion of a defensive-driving course can earn point credits; the course may be used for point reduction once in twelve months.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: A provisional-license holder reaching six points in twelve months or nine points in twenty-four months must complete a division-approved driver-improvement course.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored equal attention per accepted fact; not an official examination weight.

nodes.label: Repeated violations may require an interview with a motor-vehicle hearing officer and compliance with recommendations for retaining driving privileges.
